package com.ruoyi.majorpilot.report;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static com.ruoyi.majorpilot.report.core.ReportTestFixtures.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import com.ruoyi.majorpilot.report.core.*;
import com.ruoyi.majorpilot.report.core.ReportModels.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/** Historical hashes captured from immutable classes, not generated by the new projection. */
class ReportAnalysisVersionCompatibilityTest {
    @Test void dsOriginalVersionsRetainAllSixHashesWhenAddingTheCurrentFactFrame() throws Exception {
        // Immutable f45d9b classpath BLVvgL, before any DS frame existed.
        var goldens=Map.of(
            // Immutable Qqq8dc: DS frame v2.3, still model-input-v2 before prebound wire changes.
            "report-assessment-rubric-v2.3",List.of("ea9d3dd6c212fe3c7b94eeaa075d4cbf4b54aa9b4e401f8387b1de3bbab84bd2","57ab17ecf00812cf2c87a9ae1a656d0892f270836516f2139f313c3a69ae4579","0f4809c92753bc2da2a7ad6936011d640d76dbe85c337b9c176769c9694f6d11","0eab3bd24c9222da71331ae6d1124f4ea40084f5dede685eda59c19cef62c738","5b2441c0b1ee2e075ab06a42b9d4a38771ee30c3519ac24516c0e95b23fc29d1","82fabdc88bb96e1134e10d7b93c2f34b2ac0f3bd9ae5149b49ea6e489915d1df"),
            "report-assessment-rubric-v2",List.of("1ddaa93439ada03bab2b1d398a0dcb3a5ba632958b57c554b9a029261f3fb523","5115291e3364430a559868fcab55faa2544a99e1e3e02ff53dd6fcc4447194b9","f44bcd4dc277eb9c2f521c5a64dae958b4e45326ecae45129d61f06d3b9930de","ed1290f657ac86c0117efe692a2f1449ae7097c0e31ad9d6482d58b29eb6c62f","b3cedef09ef7a6e508b5c564bed3ef7ac1abd4b2e55cc1a5e7bbefe3b2bcdb50","a2c4ee48bf7db83816345fc9a54ef4ac10a572039e650d8d4f67c038eaddc696"),
            "report-assessment-rubric-v2.1",List.of("35392b1e2d449917010e43b5f41882a3a2c24fda3623982526a754e66d37e167","7f4edec77e6144a40947212a67668cf7a787774fefa934b56b2138407f52d168","aa572bf7f9bcf3172ed50757456902c11c94b1e9d80523ab78fcf36c0f1b0ac9","76ca47709dd24d6717d0e53662e83aa72e95716473be84d7de84cc72781d1b1d","026e5810d08b03ba48b70d00b83b73d9aa02b0136815dc331638c393f3d044f8","4807ff83082b7bbf73d5f01da3a5b1702df2bb305b82aa392189773bacb62495"),
            "report-assessment-rubric-v2.2",List.of("f467cc99e8028095703e6442e807855ed1b3f5e91095627f346a163ff189e586","1ee2150b41fa53f57cae3792710c6e49883412db300cd8c6a2990ae7bb6c7109","95936e207874f260aab794cff50c30ab9ddfb81e024b506215b3fbaf8d331138","eb93fa8aa29eb2a7a3fa32ab50a5e9f139bb28211637f802359152ba66e3428b","815caccf7aff76dd807f8e55ea0267baeb7820d1c1e75250aab8629a433081d1","2229729a9230101d80c0c1a8ce99ec9cf7fbe96f959c384932dbc60f66f25a54"));
        var core=new ReportCore(JSON);
        for(var entry:goldens.entrySet()){
            String version=entry.getKey();var original=ReportAnalysisLiveFixtures.input("ds-causal-error");var old=original.sources().getFirst();var context=(ObjectNode)old.analysisContext().deepCopy();
            var task=(ObjectNode)context.path("task");if(!version.equals("report-assessment-rubric-v2.3"))task.remove("analysisFrame");task.put("assessmentRubricVersion",version);
            for(var step:context.path("steps")){var rubric=(ObjectNode)step.path("rubric");rubric.put("version",version);rubric.set("criteria",JSON.valueToTree(ReportAnalysisContext.criteria(step.path("stepKey").asText(),version)));}
            String before=core.hash(context);ReportAnalysisContext.enrichAggregateLineage(JSON,context,asset("DATA_SCIENCE","manifest"),version);assertEquals(before,core.hash(context));assertEquals(version.equals("report-assessment-rubric-v2.3"),context.path("task").has("analysisFrame"));
            var source=new Source(old.majorCode(),old.studentPublicId(),old.pins(),old.snapshot(),old.items(),old.experienceVersion(),context);var input=new ReportInput(original.header(),original.versions(),List.of(source),original.nextRecommendation());var catalog=core.compile(input);
            var proposal=ReportAnalysisFixtures.proposal(catalog,"SUPPORTED");var analysis=(ObjectNode)proposal.analysis().deepCopy();
            // DS's first step is structured-only: the first actual open-answer reference is later.
            ((ObjectNode)analysis.path("majorAnalyses").get(0)).set("evidenceRefs",analysis.path("findings").get(0).path("evidenceRefs").deepCopy());proposal=new Proposal(proposal.schemaVersion(),proposal.reportType(),proposal.sections(),analysis);
            assertEquals(entry.getValue(),List.of(core.hash(context),core.hash(JSON.valueToTree(source)),core.hash(JSON.valueToTree(input)),catalog.catalogSha256(),core.hash(core.modelInput(catalog).content()),core.hash(core.reviewInput(catalog,proposal).content())),version);
        }
    }
    @Test void retainsFrozenBaAndAiV23InputsWhenAddingCurrentFrames() throws Exception {
        // BA-only v2.3 snapshot 02SqKE, captured before adding the DS branch.
        var goldens=Map.of("ba-good","e2782bcafa2cec13dff93ccf36833ac14a70e214ca0886bbce0158733fcbcd14","ba-concept-errors","0887b1a552185792858944ad8ca7ab49b229bdc79be09b74c6ab6d497b89f4c1","ba-unrelated","5c686fbb88b0bded5a52d55493db08aa943624838e6dc299cd1837850effe975","ba-alternative","0c1da9f99d0dfd18e5dd4cea5b928af825f5c405a509baa2ef924508cc7111fa","ai-metric-error","2beab6e647b548a1cccc6ab477203062d723783fd37d09f74b7dcc39eb6e7792");
        var core=new ReportCore(JSON);for(var entry:goldens.entrySet()){
            var original=ReportAnalysisLiveFixtures.input(entry.getKey());var old=original.sources().getFirst();var context=(ObjectNode)old.analysisContext().deepCopy();
            ((ObjectNode)context.path("task")).remove("actionTargetFrame");((ObjectNode)context.path("task")).put("assessmentRubricVersion",ReportAnalysisContext.FRAME_RUBRIC);
            if(old.majorCode().equals("AI"))((ObjectNode)context.path("task")).remove("analysisFrame");
            for(var step:context.path("steps"))((ObjectNode)step.path("rubric")).put("version",ReportAnalysisContext.FRAME_RUBRIC);
            var source=new Source(old.majorCode(),old.studentPublicId(),old.pins(),old.snapshot(),old.items(),old.experienceVersion(),context);var input=new ReportInput(original.header(),original.versions(),List.of(source),original.nextRecommendation());
            assertEquals(entry.getValue(),core.hash(core.modelInput(core.compile(input)).content()),entry.getKey());
        }
    }
    @Test void currentAiOnlyAddsItsFrameAndChangesVersionLabelsNotMaterialsOrAnswers() throws Exception {
        var input=(ObjectNode)JSON.valueToTree(ReportAnalysisLiveFixtures.input("ai-metric-error"));
        for(var source:input.path("sources")){var context=source.path("analysisContext");assertTrue(context.path("task").has("analysisFrame"));((ObjectNode)context.path("task")).remove("analysisFrame");assertFalse(context.path("task").has("aggregateLineage"));((ObjectNode)context.path("task")).put("assessmentRubricVersion","report-assessment-rubric-v2.2");for(var step:context.path("steps"))((ObjectNode)step.path("rubric")).put("version","report-assessment-rubric-v2.2");}
        // Exact immutable f45d9b input hash; only the version labels were normalized above.
        assertEquals("c7b8f5eb4976c13eaf045166ceaf78a58785df3aa3e580f2562b917fc5e9ac9b",new ReportCore(JSON).hash(input));
    }
}
